panels.title: Portfolio Equity
panels.description: Per-broker portfolio equity, same series as Portfolio Overview dashboard but scoped here for incident correlation. Source: `max(hg_portfolio_equity_usd) by (broker)`. Use in conjunction with the service-log panel below to correlate equity anomalies with log events.

panels.title: Drawdown % by Strategy
panels.description: Drawdown derived in PromQL from `hg_strategy_equity_usd` history via max_over_time over the panel's visible time range ($__range). No separate drawdown gauge; the equity gauge is the single source of truth. Always <= 0. Green > -5%, yellow -5% to -20%, red < -20%.

panels.title: Order Fill Rate (5m)
panels.description: Per-second rate of order fills over a 5-minute rolling window, by broker. Source: `sum(rate(hg_orders_filled_total[5m])) by (broker)`. Spikes are normal at rebalance times. Sustained zero during expected trading windows indicates stuck execution. `noValue: 0` renders a flat zero line when the counter has never incremented (distinguishable from a broken metric pipeline).

panels.title: Order Reject Rate (5m)
panels.description: Per-second rate of order rejections over a 5-minute rolling window, broken down by `reason` label (e.g. insufficient_funds, bad_symbol). Source: `sum(rate(hg_orders_rejected_total[5m])) by (reason)`. Flat zero is healthy. Non-zero warrants investigation via the service-log panel below. `noValue: 0` ensures 'no rejections' and 'broken pipeline' don't look identical.

panels.title: Rebalance Errors (5m)
panels.description: Per-second rate of rebalance-step failures over a 5-minute rolling window, by strategy and phase (buy, sell, close, reconcile, other). Source: `sum(rate(hg_strategy_rebalance_errors_total[5m])) by (strategy, phase)`. Counter increments whenever an individual order within a rebalance raises -- e.g. the 2026-04-24 incident where RAMP's 12 consecutive buy orders failed with 'IBKRBroker has no attribute place_order'. Healthy = flat zero. Any non-zero spike means symbols RAMP/OMR/MP tried to trade weren't actually traded.

panels.title: Homeguard Service Logs
panels.description: Live tail of every systemd unit matching `homeguard-*`, backed by Loki (promtail scrapes journald and ships to 127.0.0.1:3100). Use for correlating log lines (errors, restarts, rebalance decisions) with metric anomalies in the panels above. Promtail `max_age: 12h` means fresh sessions don't backfill older entries.
